name: Familiar de Residente (Family Member of Resident)

requirements.blocker_text: Sponsor must be a Peruvian citizen or hold Trabajador (worker) or Formación (student/training) resident status.
Spouse or common-law partner, minor children, unmarried children under 28 who are studying, adult children unable to support themselves due to disability, or parents.
Interpol international police clearance certificate (valid up to 6 months) and criminal background documentation from country of origin.

outcome.duration_length: up to 2 years for family members of Peruvian citizens; up to 1 year for family members of foreign residents, renewable

sources.title: Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (MIGRACIONES) -- Reglamento del Decreto Legislativo N.1350, Article 29.2.i: Familiar de Residente status, up to 2 years, work permitted (subordinate or independent)

Veninformado -- Familiar de Residente: qualifying relationships (spouse/partner, children to age 28 if studying, disabled adult children, parents), sponsor status requirement, 2-year duration for Peruvian sponsors vs. 1 year for foreign-resident sponsors
